t_base_note: Same F1 sweep over [0.30, 0.70) that train_pipeline() used. With a calibrated model on an 8% base rate, p_ml = 1 - P(default) concentrates near 0.92, so the sweep flags almost nothing and the F1 curve is flat and near zero. t_base is the argmax of that flat curve, not a sharp optimum.
note: Metrics are LOWER than the April synthetic artifacts reported. That is the point: those numbers came from a frame containing the model's own outputs as features. Nothing was tuned to recover the difference.
